about_the_game:
Lilium is a third-person action RPG that reimagines the ancient tale of the first woman. Step into the role of Lilith, created by the divine El yet destined to break free from the path laid before her.

Battle through extra-dimensional planes of existence, weaving your way past the angelic legions sent to drag you back into obedience. Master a unique spellcasting system where time slows and intricate hand-sign combos unleash devastating magic. Chain together physical attacks, ranged projectiles, and precise parries to overcome your foes.

As you journey deeper, uncover lost truths, gain new spells, and shape your power into the weapon you’ll need to defy the servants of heaven itself.

Key Features:

  • A dark mythic retelling of the story of Lilith, steeped in lore and symbolism.

  • Skill-based spellcasting using hand-sign input combos.

  • Fast-paced combat with melee strikes, ranged attacks, dashes, and parries.

  • Explore surreal realms and face the celestial armies of El.

Will you follow the path you were made for—or forge your own?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 3 3300X
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 / AMD RX 580 (4GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 30 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: SSD strongly recommended for faster loading times
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-9700K / AMD Ryzen 5 5600X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 3060 / AMD RX 6700 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 30 GB available space

short_description: Master precise parries, devastating counters, and dynamic spell combos as you confront celestial enemies and unravel a truth buried beneath holy lies. Every strike is a statement: every spell, a rebellion.
